versions.changelog:
- Updated default model used from u1-insuremed to u2-med in SKILL.md.
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the skill package.

- Initial release of the health-exam-abnormal-items skill.
- Provides detailed, item-by-item explanations for abnormal health check indicators in plain language.
- Analyzes potential causes (with personal background), health impacts, and gives lifestyle/medical intervention suggestions.
- Explains correlations among multiple abnormal indicators (e.g., metabolic syndrome risk assessment).
- Outputs both structured JSON and easy-to-understand summary text for each abnormal item.
- Emphasizes data privacy, minimal data use, and clear medical disclaimer (for health education, not diagnosis).
- Simple command-line usage; requires Python 3.7+ and access to internal API.
